[RLOW.3.2.1] A schema lowers to its schema group ([RDSC.8.1]): one
lifecycle atom (`SchemaTtl` or `SchemaLogical`), one `Slot` atom per declared
slot in declaration order, one `Hydration` atom per hydration-eligible slot
([RDSC.5.6]), then `SchemaSource` and `SchemaDef`. Each `Slot` atom carries the
slot's name and type. The runtime registers the schema by name into its schema
registry; the Rete alpha nodes that match on the schema reference it by that
name.
